subject: Re: On‑prem/Private demo — requested time change & preflight
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@medsecure.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: it_ops@medsecure.ai
Date: 2027-07-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Demo for Private/On‑prem options — need to move time

Hi Grace / Vivek —

Thanks for the quick self‑serve flow — we booked the 7/13 10:00 AM PT slot through the calendar but a stakeholder conflict just popped up. Can we move to 7/14 after 3:00 PM PT? Preferably 3:30–4:15 if you have it.

A couple of quick asks on our side before the demo:
- We need a brief preflight (15–20m) with your engineer to confirm network egress rules and IP allowlist — we’re strict about ingress/outbound policies.
- Please confirm whether you can bring a SOC 2 excerpt and clarify data residency options (we're US‑only).
- Also, any answers on HSM/KMS support would be helpful.

Attendees from our side: me + Derek (IT ops). If there’s a preferred preflight checklist you can share, that’d speed things up.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Head of IT Security | MedSecure AI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@medsecure.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Private/On‑prem options — need to move time

Thanks Samira — quick note from the SDR side: 7/14 3:30 PM PT works for us; I’ve tentatively blocked 3:30–4:15 PT. Grace, can you confirm engineering availability for a 20‑minute preflight earlier that day?

Attaching our short privacy intake that covers the SOC2 snapshots and high‑level data residency options (attachment: privacy-intake.pdf). Please fill the highlighted network/IP fields and return so Aditya and Grace can prep.

Next steps (simple):
- Samira: confirm 7/14 3:30 PT and complete the intake PDF
- Grace / Aditya: propose a 20m preflight window on 7/14 (ideally 12:00–2:00 PT)

Cheers — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@medsecure.ai>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-11T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Private/On‑prem options — need to move time

Samira — thanks for the heads up. 7/14 at 3:30 PT is confirmed on my calendar for the demo (30m). Vivek, thanks for the intake — I asked Aditya to join the thread for the preflight.

Proposed preflight: 7/14, 12:30–12:50 PT (20m). Goal: validate IP ranges, ports, and minimal baselining for an on‑prem proof of concept. Aditya — can you take the lead on that and confirm you can join?

We’ll bring: SOC 2 excerpt, data residency slide, and a short ops slide that explains our VPC / on‑prem attachment model. If you want, we can limit the demo attendees to just our engineering + product (Grace, Aditya) and your two people to keep it tight.

Link to the intake and the HubSpot deal are in the metadata; I’ll post a short agenda before the preflight.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@medsecure.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-12T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Private/On‑prem options — need to move time

Grace / team — 7/14 3:30 PT works, and 12:30 PT for the preflight is good too. We’ll keep attendees to Derek + myself for the preflight and the main demo. A few clarifying notes for Aditya:
- We host TLS terminated at the edge; we need to confirm whether Redwood can support mutual TLS for the control plane and whether the agent supports customer‑managed keys (KMS/HSM).
- We will provide a SOC2 paragraph and network CIDR list before the preflight.

Thanks for being flexible — appreciate the limited attendee option. We’ll return the completed intake by end of day.

On Mon, Jul 11, 2027 at 9:18 AM Samira Khan <samira.k@medsecure.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick self‑serve flow — we booked the 7/13 10:00 AM PT slot through the calendar but a stakeholder conflict just popped up.

Regards,
Samira
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@medsecure.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-12T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Private/On‑prem options — need to move time

Hi Samira — I’ll take the preflight on 7/14 12:30 PT. A few quick confirmations so we can be efficient:
- mTLS: our control plane supports mTLS for dedicated/private deployments; we can provide the client cert flow during preflight.
- KMS/HSM: we integrate with customer‑managed KMS for key encryption at rest; HSM integrations are available for Dedicated/Private pilots — I’ll bring the ops doc.
- Please send the CIDR ranges and any proxy / NAT gateway details you require allowed outbound (attachment: network-checklist.csv).

If you share the intake before EOD, I’ll draft a 6‑point preflight checklist and the minimal firewall entries so Derek can crosswalk with network.

See you 7/14 — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
